scope: Real faults of real cheap-tier outputs recorded as genuine transfers of the arena rounds. The contained run (run_contained.py) counts an error-level finding on a genuine transfer as a false alarm unless it matches an entry exactly (round, channel, claim, code, agent); every entry must be raised as an error on its genuine transfer (gate adjudicated_genuine_faults_raised: a missing one fails the run); on an arena fault variant of the same task, an error matching an entry for the same claim is not a disagreement with the receipt.
rules: adjudicate only a fault a deterministic check decides and the engine evidence of this record reproduces
never adjudicate to silence a finding: an entry makes the run stricter (its fault must keep being raised)

a new or changed entry is a new version of this file, with its evidence; an entry is retired only by a new version that states why (for example: the translator no longer delivers the encoding), never silently
